headline: DinDin drops new single 'CAKE' on his birthday
sub: An upbeat cheer song for everyone getting through a long day
caption:
DinDin is back with a new single, 'CAKE', and it drops on his birthday!

The rapper releases 'CAKE' today (Nov 20) at 6 PM KST. Packed with his signature positive energy, the song is a message of support for everyone pushing through a tough day.

📌 Source: Yonhap News, Munhwa Ilbo (via Korean media)
